subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: Should this umbrella native VPS performance item remain open as the runbook/synthesis issue, or be split in favor of narrower performance issues?
rationale: The repository now has multiple narrower performance issues and PRs, but none fully owns the requested layer-by-layer analysis, quick wins, code improvements, and instrumentation gaps.

options.title: Keep as runbook umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to define the cross-layer measurement runbook and link narrower hot-spot issues underneath it.

options.title: Split into narrow issues
options.body: Create or select canonical issues for each layer and close this after preserving the original VPS context in those links.

options.title: Pick one canonical perf issue
options.body: Declare a narrower existing issue as canonical, accepting that context, memory, Telegram, auth, and OS parts may be out of scope there.

recommendation.title: Keep as runbook umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to define the cross-layer measurement runbook and link narrower hot-spot issues underneath it.

likelyOwner.reason: The current inspected docs/runtime provenance and broad current-main blame point most consistently to vincentkoc for routing the umbrella decision.
